title: eval
category: sub-skill of concept-art · 6-gate concept & originality audit
short_summary: audits 2k plates against 01-anchor coherence, anti-clone originality vs. 5 standout benchmarks, canon.md agreement, 2k footers, surface distinctness, and the 3-round cap.
when_to_use: use at stage 5 of jason-design-agent after image-gen or polish renders any 2k concept plate.
summary: Evaluates generated 2K Nano Banana 2 concept images across the 4x3 = 12 matrix (3 web, 3 app, 3 distinct components, 3 unique interactive experiences) against the locked style direction, Prompt 01 constitution, canon.md domain state, and the 5 standout benchmark research dossiers and screenshots. Audits six gates—Prompt 01 coherence, anti-clone originality (zero copied fonts, palettes, or layouts), canon.md data agreement, 2K geometry and footer completeness, component and experience distinctness, and Nano Banana round budget compliance (max 3 rounds)—emitting surgical polish directives until passed or capped. Use inside jason-design-agent after image-gen or polish renders any 2K plate. Don't use for frontend code or DOM scoring (use jason-dev-agent).
